name: Contrarian take
what: Common belief -> why it's backwards -> 3 reasons -> what to do -> genuine 'where do you disagree?'
template: After <N projects>, I think it's backwards.
specs: 700-900 chars; hook <=140 chars over 2 lines; 0-3 hashtags; single blank lines

name: Framework post

template: Most teams skip step <X>, and that's where <cost> comes from.
specs: 700-1,300 chars; pair with a framework carousel for saves
compliance: Clinic directors: linkedin-playbook.md §8 gate (no testimonials, recommendations, superlatives, offers)

name: Listicle

compliance: Clinic directors: linkedin-playbook.md §8 gate (no testimonials, recommendations, superlatives, offers)

name: Behind the scenes

compliance: Clinic directors: linkedin-playbook.md §8 gate (no testimonials, recommendations, superlatives, offers)

name: Case study (anonymised, permissioned)

compliance: TITAN.AI only, written client permission. Never clinics (testimonial rules).

name: Story -> principle (SLAY)

What it means in SG/MY/UK specifically: <...>.

name: How-to

compliance: Clinic directors: linkedin-playbook.md §8 gate (no testimonials, recommendations, superlatives, offers)

name: Genuine question / debate

Talking head 9:16/4:5, 2-4 word captions in lower third
B-roll / screen recording every 3-6 s on key nouns
One CTA line at the end

name: LinkedIn newsletter edition

name: Poll (genuine only)

Context in post text: why you're asking
